groups.defect: ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled throws UnsupportedOperationException when invoked by the removal cleanup listener, potentially failing client deletion.
groups.rationale: Both report the same lifecycle call reaching the throwing V2 override. The additional methods mentioned provide context or proposed fixes, rather than separate reported defects.

groups.defect: The Javadocs for requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() incorrectly describe boolean return values instead of their void/throws contracts.
groups.rationale: The first two suggestions report separate instances of the same documentation mistake, and the third explicitly reports both. Both method comments require correction.
